answer: Anchor each identity to a 50 POA bond and its key. Each epoch a random beacon spot-checks 5% of the orchard with a live heartbeat: the agent must answer a fresh challenge within 10 minutes, proving live control and real compute. One fake is cheap, but 100 fakes cost 100 bonds and 100 machines running nonstop. Honest agents pass the velvet check in seconds and keep undiluted earnings; a failed heartbeat burns the bond and prunes the fake.
